title: Dissociation of Nuclear Suspensions
author: Emi Sei
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.t3aeqie

steps.title: Prepare tissue and mince
steps.instruction: Cut fresh or frozen tissue into ~1 × 1 × 1 cm pieces, mince with a scalpel in a 10‑cm Petri dish containing 2 mL NST‑DAPI buffer for 10–15 min until no visible chunks remain.

steps.title: Filter nuclei suspension
steps.instruction: Transfer the minced mixture through a 40 µL FlowMi filter into 1.5 mL DNA LoBind tubes and keep the tubes on ice.

steps.title: Centrifuge nuclei
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the tubes at 4 °C, 300–500 × g for 5 min.

steps.title: First nuclei wash
steps.instruction: Carefully discard the supernatant and resuspend the pellet in 1 mL cold Nuclei Wash and Resuspension Buffer.

steps.title: Second nuclei wash
steps.instruction: Add 1 mL cold Nuclei Wash and Resuspension Buffer, gently resuspend the pellet, then discard the supernatant.

steps.title: Resuspend and count nuclei
steps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet in cold Nuclei Wash and Resuspension Buffer, prepare a 1:1 Hoechst‑PI solution, add 2 µL of this mix to 10 µL filtered nuclei, and count cells using a Countess II FL.

steps.title: Proceed to downstream assay
steps.instruction: Immediately use the nuclei for 10X Genomics RNA experiments or single‑cell DNA sequencing experiments.

steps.title: Third nuclei wash
steps.instruction: Wash the nuclei a final time with 1 mL cold Nuclei Wash and Resuspension Buffer.
